notes: Route: robots.txt (status 200, permissive for article paths, advertises Sitemap) -> https://www.rte.ie/sitemap.xml (200, index of numbered chunks /data-feed/sitemap/sitemap-N.xml, N=0,10000,...,380000; N=0 is newest) -> each chunk is a flat urlset with <loc>+<lastmod> (all 200). Chunks are sorted by lastmod descending: chunk 0 covers lastmod down to ~2026-09-25 region, chunk 10000 max lastmod = 2026-08-06 (before window), so an article published in-window (lastmod >= publication date) can only live in chunk 0. Script walks N ascending, stops at first chunk whose max lastmod < 2026-09-25, and keeps only URLs with the RTE permalink date /YYYY/MMDD/ (section/landing pages have no date path and are skipped). Date = that permalink date: it is the site's publication date and was verified equal to JSON-LD datePublished (2026-09-30, 2026-10-10, 2026-10-20 samples all exact match); sitemap <lastmod> was deliberately NOT used as the date because it is edit time (e.g. chunk 0 contains 2010-2026 old articles recently edited). Result: 3655 unique URLs, 31/31 days (min day 59, 2026-09-30=133, 2026-10-10=83, 2026-10-20=148). Runtime ~2s warm (sitemap index + chunk 0, both cached by polite_fetch); a cold run is 2 requests plus the stop-check on chunk 10000. Verified 4 random samples: all 200, 2463-5242 visible chars, page date within 1 day (exact).
